//: The Muster instance is also the named local server instance, so
yas --on local:${INSTANCE} reaches this exact development server.
That name is the whole socket configuration: --name runs the same
automatic resolver a packaged server runs, and bin/dev-server points
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at the owner-private runtime directory so both land on
the same path. An explicit YAS_SOCK from ${YAS_SOCKET} only restated
what the name already decides.
The server's socket lock replaces an older attempt and removes stale sockets.
restartOnSuccess stays false: the flock-based replacement exits 0 on purpose
and retrying that loops forever.
timeoutStop 15s so AudioPipeline::drop can kill dbus/pipewire/pw-cat in order.
The staged build dependency keeps this server running while a replacement
binary compiles. Muster restarts this unit only after that build succeeds;
a failed replacement leaves the current server in service.
YAS_EDGE=1 serves the browser from this process, which is how a deployed
server does it (nix/nixos-module.nix, nix/darwin-module.nix): one unit to
supervise and no socket between the browser and the terminals. The edge
keeps the port it had as its own unit, so the UI's YAS_DEV_EDGE_PORT and
the stack's port block are unchanged. YAS_PASSPHRASE comes from
.env.local through direnv.
The WebTransport bind and advertised port are pinned to that same allocated
port so ambient service settings cannot make worktrees contend for :3264.
YAS_FONT_EXPORT=1 because serving font bytes over the protocol is the
feature under development: without it the browser silently renders with
whatever the viewing machine happens to have installed under the same
name, which looks like the feature working on the developer's own screen
and like nothing at all everywhere else. OS/2 embedding bits still decide
per face.
Readiness is the edge's HTTP listener, not the Unix socket: the server's
own FS STAT answers Unsupported for anything that is not a file, a
directory, or a symlink (crates/server/src/yas_fs.rs stat_entry), so a
`path` probe at a socket can never be satisfied and the unit died of its
start timeout while the server it was watching was up and healthy.
